input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: Undocumented arguments return `None` as their description instead of an empty string. Return `self.help or ""` to preserve the formatter's expected string value.
- rationale: When a command has both a documented argument and an argument with `help=None`, the documented argument enables the positional-arguments section. The undocumented argument now supplies `(metavar, None)` to `formatter.write_dl`, replacing the previous `(metavar, "")` fallback. The formatter expects strings, so rendering `--help` raises a TypeError instead of displaying help.
critique: The finding points to the same faulty operation: get_help_record returns None for help instead of an empty string. It also describes the same failure, where a mix of documented and undocumented arguments sends (metavar, None) to write_dl and --help raises a TypeError.
